answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the glacier of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The summit lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the mirror is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
